normal: consist of two main part, the inner bore that should be clean and free of any foreign particles, debris, or contamination. And finish part which consists of the outer rim and glass transition area, and should have a smooth, intact free from any chips, cracks, or fractures.
contamination: bottle containing internal debris, foreign matter, or any contamination in the inner bore of the bottle
broken_small: a break or chip on the finish part of the bottle, covering less than 20% of the finish circumference
broken_large: a break on the finish part of the bottle, covering 20% or more of the finish circumference

normal: has three distinct conductive cores enclosed in a whitish outer insulation. Each core is positioned within its respective colored insulation: yellow-green (top), blue (bottom left), and brown (bottom right). The conductors are composed of tightly packed copper strands.
cut_outer_insulation: the anomaly is located on the whitish outer sheath and appears as a visible cut
missing_wire: the anomaly is located on the copper strands and involves missing, eroded, blackened, corroded, or visibly reduced copper strands
poke_insulation: the anomaly is located on the whitish outer sheath and appears as rapture, punctures, crumbling, or holes
missing_cable: the anomaly is located on the conductor core (including the colored part) and one or more entire conductor cores are missing
cable_swap: the anomaly is located on the insulation colors (yellow-green, blue, or brown) and one of the three expected insulation colors is missing
cut_inner_insulation: the anomaly is located on the colored conductor core (including the colored part) and involves physical damage, deformation, or irregular arrangement of the colored inner insulation
bent_wire: the anomaly is located solely on the copper strands without including the colored conductive core and involves irregularly protruding copper strands while the overall core shape remains intact

normal: appears to be in good condition with no visible defects or damage. The '500' label on the brownish-orange part is clear and legible, and any rotational misalignment of the black part is acceptable.
crack: identified as a visible defect on the surface of the capsule that penetrates deeper than the superficial layer and breaks the smooth surface continuity. Cracks can be visible on either the black or brownish-orange part of the capsule. Typical signs of a crack include the presence of underlying material, which may sometimes appear as a whitish substance leaking or accumulating around the crack
faulty_imprint: partial or complete fault in imprint of label 500
poke: identifies as a visible defect on the surface of the capsule that penetrates deeper than the superficial layer and breaks the smooth surface continuity. Holes can be visible on either the black or brownish-orange part of the capsule. Typical signs of a hole include the presence of underlying material, which may sometimes appear as a whitish substance leaking or accumulating around the hole
scratch: visible scratches or scuff marks on its surface. These scratches might be linear or randomly oriented. They affect only the superficial layer of the capsule without penetrating deeper into the shell and without presence of whitish substance
squeeze: physical deformities such as squeezing, denting, or warping. These deformities alter the shape of the capsule without causing any breach in the capsule's shell

normal: has uniform and tightly woven pattern, free of any visible defects such as stains, frayed edges, or loose threads. The fibers are intact and consistently distributed, ensuring both aesthetic appeal and structural integrity.
color: colored spot (dark, blue, or red), indicating a stain or spill that has been absorbed into the carpet fibers
cut: tear resulting from cuts, or missing threads in the fabric weave
hole: gaps or holes that do not look like a cut
metal_contamination: presence of extraneous materials such as metallic pieces embedded in the carpet weave
thread: loose extra thread piece protruding from the carpet surface

normal: has uniformly arranged, diamond-shaped cells that are consistently sized and evenly spaced.
bent: grid pattern is interrupted by small bent or deformed wires causing local curvature irregularities
broken: grid pattern has broken wires with visible gaps and fractured segments
glue: grid pattern is partially obscured by a glossy or semi-transparent residue that distorts the visual uniformity
metal_contamination: grid pattern is disrupted by an irregularly shaped metallic protrusion fused to the structure, blending in color but breaking the geometric flow
thread: grid pattern is entangled with fine fibrous strands, either clustered in a knot or stretched loosely across the surface

normal: characterized with a smooth, unblemished shell. The shell is a light brown color with a slightly textured surface, featuring small ridges and grooves.
crack: fissure or crack on the shell of hazelnut
cut: long, linear scratch on the surface of the hazelnut shell
hole: small circular hole in the shell
print: whitish substance or stain on the shell of the hazelnut

normal: consistent grain patterns and a uniform color. The texture is smooth, and slightly textured.
color: Unintended light grayish or redish discolorations on the leather surface that visibly contrast with the surrounding materiale
cut: cut, slit, or tear on the leather surface. The cut may include a small hole but is distinguished by the presence of a linear or curved opening extending outward from the puncture point.
fold: a raised area or strip in the leather caused by folding
glue: The presence of a transparent foreign substance or wet mark, often appearing as a transparent residue or a slightly darker area than the leather itself, suggesting glue, liquid, or embedded material
poke: a small, isolated, visible hole penetrating through the leather surface, without any visible cuts or tears extending from it

normal: have an irregular pentagonal shape with a central threaded hole. The surface textures and edges are relatively consistent, but with some visible wear or surface inconsistencies as typical for metal parts.
bent: irregularities and distortions along the edges of the nut, appearing to include extra metal pieces or protrusions along the edge
color: abnormal blue, dark, or red colors on the surface of the metal nut
flip: irregularly shaped lobes, leading to a loss of the characteristic hexagonal symmetry
scratch: visible scratches or abrasions on the surface of the metal nut

normal: has white and oval shape, with red speckling uniformly distributed across the surface. The FF logo is imprinted on one side. The overall appearance is consistent across different units.
color: unintended spots or marks, streak, or patches of different colors (bright red, dark blue, solid red, yellow) are present on the pill's surface
contamination: abnormal bumps or protrusions on the pill's surface, indicating contamination or impurities
crack: missing parts along the edge, indicating chopping or breakage. This anomaly strictly pertains to the edges of the pill
faulty_imprint: the imprinted FF logo is partially missing
pill_type: uneven pigmentation and unusual coloration, differing significantly from the normal uniform appearance
scratch: visible surface imperfections such as scratches or indented marks

normal: has 3 components: head, shank, and thread. The head is flat and has a slot for a screwdriver. The shank is cylindrical and smooth. The thread is spiral and wraps around the shank and continue to the pointed tip, which helps in starting the screw into the material.
manipulated_front: deformation at the tip of the thread, affecting its ability to penetrate materials effectively
scratch_head: damage or scratch on the top head of the screw
scratch_neck: scratch or deformity on the shank of the screw
thread_side: defects or irregularities in the threading, where the serrated edges are damaged
thread_top: defects or irregularities in the threading, where the serrated edges are damaged

normal: exhibit a uniform speckled appearance with a consistent distribution of darker spots on a lighter background. The surface texture appears smooth and free of visible cracks or irregularities
crack: prominent, deep cracks on the surface of the tile, often intersecting to from  branching patterns. These fissures may compromise the tile's structural integrity
glue_strip: presence of adhesive material or tape remnants on the tile surface, which disrupt the tile's uniform pattern and aesthetic quality. The residue typically manifests as transparent or semi-transparent patches with irregular shapes
gray_stroke: irregular, dark patches that disrupt the uniform pattern of the tile, resembling smudges or stain marks
oil: exhibit areas of resin contamination, characterized by localized patches where resin has pooled and solidified. These resin spots appear as translucent or discolored areas that stand out against the intended surface design
rough: streak-like abrasions, often appearing as elongated, thin, irregular patches that disrupt the uniform speckled pattern of the tile

normal: housed in a black plastic package with three metallic leads. The transistor is inserted into a protoboard. The leads of transistor are inserted into separate holes in a single horizontal row. The transistor is positioned vertically on the protoboard, and their black plastic bodies are oriented upright.
bent_lead: one of the leads is protruding or fraying out but with a full length
cut_lead: one lead is partially cut. The defining characteristic is that the lead appears shortened or truncated compared to the others. The cut lead does not show a change in direction but rather a reduction in length
damaged_case: damage in the encapsulating packages, often resulting in the exposure of internal components
misplaced: transistor is either entirely absent from the protoboard, placed incorrectly such that it does not maintain the proper orientation, or has more than one lead bent or misaligned

normal: exhibits a consistent, straight-grain texture with minimal imperfections. The surface is smooth with a uniform reddish-brown color.
color: typically appearing as spots or smudges, caused by infilteration of ink or dye substances onto the wood surface
hole: small, round holes typically caused by insects or mechanical drilling
liquid: presence of areas where liquid like resin has accumulated and disrupted the wood grain
scratch: the wood has been abraded with visible scratches, scuffs, or gaugs. These scratches can affect both appearance and structural integrity

normal: features two primary components: consists of two primary components: the tape and the coil. The tape is a fabric strip with a uniform texture and color, free from fraying or pilling. The coil is made of durable material, interlocking evenly with consistent spacing, and has a smooth surface without deformation.
broken_teeth: portions of the coil exhibit an unusual shiny surface texture compared to the rest. This anomaly can be characterized by changes directly on the teeth, including any unusual shine. Additionally, this anomaly may sometimes cause the fabric to lie on the coil teeth themselves instead of just beside them
fabric_border: the textile tape edges have visible fraying or unraveling. This anomaly is strictly confined to the outermost edges of the zipper tape, regardless of texture
fabric_interior: characterized by the presence of small balls of fiber on the fabric adjacent to the zipper, but crucially not on the edge. It lies between the very border of the tape and zipper. This anomaly impacts the fabric surrounding the zipper rather than the coil or teeth themselves
rough: portions of the coil exhibit an unusual rough surface texture compared to the rest. This anomaly can be characterized by changes directly on the teeth, including rough or jagged edges
split_teeth: chain is partially unzipped in a small section, causing a minor gap between the teeth
squeezed_teeth: coil appears deformed due to being tightly compressed, squeezed, or pinched. This distortion typically causes the individual teeth of the coil to overlap horizontally
